nameOrigin: a bird’s claw (especially birds of prey)

pokedexEntries.x: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

pokedexEntries.or: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

pokedexEntries.y: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

pokedexEntries.as: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

pokedexEntries.su: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.

pokedexEntries.mo: It zooms directly at its prey at flight speeds of close to 310 mph, while fiery embers scatter from gaps in its feathers.

pokedexEntries.us: Its tough wings don’t allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters’ outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

pokedexEntries.um: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

pokedexEntries.sw: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

pokedexEntries.sh: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.
